newsitem.title: USA: San Antonio feeder cattle steady-firm - USDA.
newsitem.headline: San Antonio feeder cattle steady-firm - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers and heifers were steady to firm, except 800-900 lb heifers $2.00-$4.00 per cwt higher in a light test, compared to last week, USDA said.

Trade active. Demand good. Bulk of supply Medium and Large 1-2 600-900 lb feeder steers and heifers. Supply included around 5 percent slaughter cows and bulls, 60 percent feeder cattle over 600 lbs with balance mostly feeder cattle under 600 lbs.

Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 - 600-700 lbs 72.75-78.75, pkg 605 lbs 79.50; 700-800 lbs 70.50-75.00; 800-900 lbs 63.00-70.50, pkg 819 lbs 72.75. Medium and Large 1-2 - 500-600 lbs 69.50-75.50; 700-800 lbs 61.00. Cattle and Calves - 1,349 Last week - 1,963 Last Year - 1,420
